escalation.ask: Contact the organisation that runs the national payment network to restore service. Clearing will drain its 124 pending items once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 101: it waits because of the network timeout, not because it is malformed.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed. The national payment network is down and not answering, so clearing cannot send posted payments and its queue is backing up with 124 pending items.
sbar.background: The external national payment network stopped answering, and 100% of requests to it fail. Clearing logs show 'network_send_failed msg=payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=101'.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage of the national payment network (confidence 0.93). Item 101 is not poison: it waits only because the network times out. The screening-standby restarts were operator and maintenance events with no symptom, and no allowed action could fix the network.
sbar.recommendation: The incident commander escalated to the organisation that runs the national payment network; follow up with them until service is restored, then confirm clearing drains its 124 pending items. Do not quarantine item 101. Operations should review the 124 delayed posted payments for any customer or settlement effects.
